name: gPodder
blurb: gPodder lets you manage your Podcast subscriptions, discover new content and download episodes to your devices.
description:
gPodder lets you manage your Podcast subscriptions, discover new content and download episodes to your devices.

You can also take advantage of the service gpodder.net, which lets you sync subscriptions, playback progress and starred episodes.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
